notes: One entry per P2ID address scheme, keyed by its domain (p2id.vault.vN). A scheme fixes every address: p2id = CREATE2(factory, identityHash, vaultInitCodeHash), with identityHash computed under identityDomain. The scheme domain is also the factory's namespace (nsHash = keccak256(domain)) and the deterministic-deployment salt, so it is an input to the addresses, not only a label. Entries are history: once `factory` is recorded the entry is frozen, and a vault change means adding p2id.vault.v(N+1) and moving `current`; older schemes stay derivable forever. While `factory` is null, `node scripts/embed-p2id.mjs --update` refreshes vaultInitCodeHash from the Hardhat artifact.
